text:
tasha: Aster Health asked if Redwood can be a drop-in replacement for HeliosAPI. Minimal client changes, same sync/async shapes, security questionnaire due EOW. can we POC?
diego: Yes in principle. Key compatibility items: request shape (`context` + `meta`), async webhook callbacks, header semantics (`X-Helios-Req`), and streaming framing (chunked JSON). Need acceptance criteria.
ben: They are HIPAA. Priya, we'll need BAA, KMS details, audit retention (they asked about 7y).
priya: I started the questionnaire. Hosted vs Dedicated matters: hosted = Redwood-managed KMS, no customer tokens; dedicated = mTLS and customer keys. I'll list options.
frank: Need sample cURL + webhook secret to prototype. Async callback changes flow a lot. If they expect idempotency via `dedupe_token`, we must honor it.
tasha: customer sample (trimmed): `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer HELIOS_KEY" -d '{"context":"Note","max_length":300,"callback_url":"https://x"}' https://api.helios.ai/v2/complete` and async callback shape pasted in doc.
diego: Plan: build a lightweight proxy that maps Helios endpoints to Redwood, translates headers, maps errors (422/409 mapping), and proxies callbacks. For streaming, transform SSE -> chunked JSON lines.
frank: I'll prototype node/express shim. ETA 2 business days if I get samples. Will post staging endpoint.
sam: We'll run parity evals. Suggest initial N=50 canonical clinical notes to compare outputs with their current vendor. Need metric agreement (F1 on entities + manual QA). Note: exact byte parity unlikely due to tokenization/sampling differences.
ben: Pricing ask: they want preserved per-req price for 90 days. Sales can propose pilot credit or blended rate; finance needs to sign off.
priya: Ops/security note: Hosted cannot accept customer-supplied tokens. We'll propose an auth proxy that validates Helios tokens and mints ephemeral Redwood tokens and logs mappings. Dedicated supports customer-managed tokens/mTLS.
diego: Also must handle webhook signing header name; their clients expect `x-helios-signature`. Shim should sign callbacks accordingly and respect retry semantics.
frank: deploy-bot: deploy started by frank for branch integration/aster-compat at commit d4e5f - staging proxy: https://staging-proxy.redwood.net/helios/v2/complete
frank: Staging up. Sync flow OK; async callback signing name fixed next.
sam: I'll run eval harness on 50 examples today and post diffs in ~3h.
tasha: Action items: frank -> shim prototype, diego -> header/error mapping + idempotency, priya -> questionnaire & BAA options, sam -> parity tests, ben -> pricing ask to finance, tasha -> SOW draft.
priya: Uploaded questionnaire draft and BAA placeholder to Aster folder.
tasha: I'll send the POC plan to the customer and request canonical prompt set + metric thresholds. Follow-ups Monday unless urgent. :thumbsup:
